# DisableToolBarItem

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Toolbars](BlitzPlus-Toolbars)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
DisableToolBarItem toolbar:Int32, index:Int32
```

## Description

Greys out one icon of a toolbar. It no longer reacts and sends no events. [EnableToolBarItem](EnableToolBarItem) turns it back on.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `toolbar` | Int32 | required | Handle of a toolbar. |
| `index` | Int32 | required | Number of the icon, counted from 0 and not counting gaps. |

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
strip = CreateImage(32, 16)
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(strip)
Color 255, 0, 255 : Rect 0, 0, 32, 16, 1
Color 200, 40, 40 : Rect 2, 2, 12, 12, 1
Color 40, 140, 40 : Oval 18, 2, 12, 12, 1
SaveImage strip, "icons.bmp"
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
win = CreateWindow("Off", 10, 10, 300, 100, Desktop(), 3)
bar = CreateToolBar("icons.bmp", 0, 0, 280, 28, win)
DisableToolBarItem bar, 1
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
